availability_audit: CHRONOLOGY-LEGAL FOR ROUTE 103. Book C01: the player chooses BOTH starters and the rival takes the unchosen third; this is the _TREECKO alias, so the rival holds Torchic and the player holds TREECKO + MUDKIP. Book C01/C03/C02 play order is Littleroot -> Route101 -> Oldale -> Route103 rival. Only two wild tables precede this battle: wild:Route101/land_mons and wild:Route103/land_mons (pool-14.json). GROWLITHE, CORPHISH = Route103 land; MIENFOO = Route101 land. HOOTHOOT = Route103 land. No fishing member: Mom gives the Old Rod only AFTER this battle (book C02), so Route102/Route103 old_rod is excluded. No evolved member: Rustboro sells the six common stones only from first arrival (book, money section), which is many chapters later, and no friendship/level evolution of a Route101/103 species completes at or below cap 14. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species. Held items are ordinary free-preparation catalogue items, one each.
plan: Answer the authored crack list with what Route 101/103 actually offers. Grass/powder immunity = Treecko (also resists Electric, immune to Leech Seed and Giga Drain drain-lock) and Insomnia Hoothoot as the second Spore-proof body. Electric immunity is NOT available this early - Treecko's resistance is the honest substitute. Priority denial = Intimidate Growlithe plus Corphish Aqua Jet and Mienfoo Fake Out to contest the Fake Out tempo. Double targeting = focus the Light Ball Pikachu turn one. Denying free setup = Knock Off on Eviolite/Light Ball/Toxic Orb. Growlithe's WILD_CHARGE is the single-target Electric probe for the Lightning Rod redirection check. Mudkip's WIDE_GUARD is the Heat Wave / Electroweb check.
